8260318.en: No sooner has she departed than an arachnid descends from above, landing in your palm. The creature delivers a sharp bite, sending a jolt of pain through your hand before leaping away. As you follow its trail, you encounter an enormous web nearby. Four words are woven into its strands, "She still harbors secrets." However, before you can ponder their meaning, the web catches fire for no reason and crumbles to ash after a brief, acrid smell.
8260318.ch: 霜凌才离开，一只蜘蛛从空中落下，掉在你手掌之中。那蜘蛛轻咬你一口，让你手掌剧痛，然后从旁跳开。你追寻蜘蛛踪迹，只见不远悬着一个巨大的蛛网，上面纵横交织写着“她还有秘密”五字。你未及思索其中含义，蛛网无火自燃，一阵焦臭后，蛛网已然化为灰烬。

8260319.en: This time, we should make a trip to Yun Mo again. Will you... accompany me?
8260319.ch: 这回我们还是去云陌州走一趟。你……来吗？

8260320.en: Very well. Should interactions with others there prove unavoidable, I'll leave the task of dealing with them to you.
8260320.ch: 嗯，入城以后若不得已与旁人接触交流，便由你应付吧。

8260321.en: This place was once a sanctuary where great cultivators sought solitude and insight. Now it has become a lair for monsters. Proceeding further will undoubtedly be perilous. Are you prepared for what lies ahead?
8260321.ch: 这原来是往日大能清修参悟的所在，后来为妖兽聚集之所在，再往前行必有危险，你可准备好了？

8260322.en: I fear the monsters within may prove formidable. I shall enter with you to confront these creatures together.
8260322.ch: 只怕里面妖兽不易应付，我与你一同进入对付妖物。

8260323.en: We've obtained the manual. Let's depart.

8260324.en: After acquiring the manual, a hint of a smile unexpectedly graces her frost-like countenance. Contrary to her usual habit, she refrains from departing on her sword. Instead, she walks beside you, strolling at a relaxed pace.
8260324.ch: 霜凌取得秘籍后，冷若冰霜的脸上竟绽开一丝笑意，她也没有像往日一般，御剑离开，只是慢悠悠的走在你旁边，漫步而行。

8260325.en: Hey, I've been bossing you around all this time. Do you feel irritated?
8260325.ch: 喂，我一直使唤你，不生气？

8260326.en: Very well. When we return, I'll reward you with an extra half jin of Wind Essence Bamboo.
8260326.ch: 好，回头我给你多送半斤精风竹。

8260327.en: Oh, I didn't expect you to be so petty, holding onto every little word I say...
8260327.ch: 哼，没想到你这么小气，将这话也记在心里……

8260328.en: At that time, I merely wished for you to leave. That's why I spoke those harsh words.
8260328.ch: 我当时只想你快快走开，这才说句狠话。

8260329.en: She smiles and turns her head away. Suddenly, you feel a cool sensation on your hand as if her finger has brushed against yours.
8260329.ch: 霜凌盈盈一笑，偏过了头。你手上却突然微微一凉，似乎碰触到霜凌的手指。

8260330.en: You touch her fair hand in return. She feels your motion; her fine brows furrow as a complex light flickers in her eyes. In an instant, her gaze becomes both resolute and tender as if the ice within her has melted, leaving behind the tranquil depths of autumn water.
8260330.ch: 你轻轻接触霜凌玉手，她略有所觉，纤眉皱起，眼中神光变得十分复杂，但只眨眼间便变得坚定温柔，仿佛寒冰化解，变作一泓秋水。

8260331.en: She seems to have made a decision. Her hand touches yours as if encouraging you to take hold of it. However, at that very moment, several cultivators suddenly appear on your path, shouting something at you.
8260331.ch: 霜凌似乎下了什么决心，玉手与你碰触，似乎正鼓励你正式牵着她的素手。然则就在此时，数名修士突然现身吆喝，拦住你两。

8260332.en: That's the demoness I was talking about!

8260333.en: Well, you wicked cultivator! We couldn't touch you while you were in the Everfrost, but now you dare to enter Yun Mo!
8260333.ch: 好你个邪修，平日找不到你拿你没法，今日你却来到云陌州之中！

8260334.en: With their words, the two cultivators launch their attack against you both.
8260334.ch: 两名修士说完竟出手朝你两攻来。

8260335.en: You defeated the two attackers, but to your dismay, more cultivators are arriving. Several of them even surround her. As she fends them off, an unexpected surge of coldness erupts in all directions. Frost and ice grow wildly and unchecked, and the cultivators are instantly frozen solid as if being drained of all vitality.
8260335.ch: 你将两人击败，岂料周边修士不断前来，其中数人已出手围住霜凌。只未料她招架应对之际，四方寒气激涌，寒霜玄冰疯长不已，几名修士仿佛阳气泄尽，立被冻成坚冰。

8260337.en: We'll deal with her accomplice! The rest of you, capture that white-haired demoness!
8260337.ch: 我们去对付她的同伙，你们去拿拿白毛女妖！

8260338.en: Alarm flashes in her eyes as she sees the cultivators surrounding you. She forms a seal at the quickest speed, releasing streams of energy toward your direction. Unexpectedly, as soon as she acts, ice spikes pierce from the ground in rapid succession. In the blink of an eye, the area around you becomes a wintry land...
8260338.ch: 霜凌眼看修士朝你围来，目露惊色，连忙手作法诀，射出道道灵力替你解围。却未料只一发动，周围玄冰如刺，次第突起，只眨眼间你身边即变成了一小片雪域……

8260339.en: The remaining cultivators are turned into solid ice; their vitality is soon extinguished. You, too, are affected by the frigid energy; an unrelenting, icy pain begins to torture you.
8260339.ch: 至于其余修士，莫不生机断绝，变作坚冰。而你似乎也受到寒气影响，全身冰冷刺痛不已。

8260341.en: Seeing your dire condition, she rushes to your aid. However, the moment she tries to support you, a surge of energy courses through your body, causing excruciating pain...
8260341.ch: 霜凌眼看你情况不妙，忙来查看，不料只一相扶，寒气汹涌而入，叫你痛苦难当……

8260343.en: Startled, she hastily steps back. Her face turns deathly pale as she glances at her own hands, then at you. Finally, with a resigned smile, she turns and trots away...
8260343.ch: 霜凌吃了一惊，忙不迭退了几步。她脸色煞白，先看了看自己双手又看了看你，最后无奈一笑，转身快步离开……

8260344.en: Though she has departed, the icy energy within your body continues to eat away your vitality...
8260344.ch: 霜凌虽已离去，但体内寒气仍不断蚕食你的生机……

8260345.en: You tried to suppress it, and fortunately, the energy subsided somewhat. At last, you're able to move again...
8260345.ch: 经过你压制后，寒气有所收敛，你终于能重新行动……

8260346.en: You walk beside her in a calm demeanor. Suddenly, a warm, comforting feeling spreads across your hand. You realize the lady beside you has gently rested her finger on your little finger.
8260346.ch: 你抱着平常心与霜凌并肩而行，突然间手上生出一阵温馨的暖意，原来身边佳人手指已经轻轻搭在你的小指头上。

8260347.en: You glance at her and notice her biting her lips, a look of determination breaking through her icy visage. You feel her grasp tightening and gently enveloping your palm. However, at that very moment, several cultivators suddenly appear on your path, shouting something at you.
8260347.ch: 回看霜凌，她贝齿咬紧，冰冷的玉容中透出一股决心，你只觉她素手微微收紧，已将你手掌轻轻包裹住了。然则就在此时，数名修士突然现身吆喝，拦住你两。

8260350.en: With their words, the two cultivators launch their fierce attack against you both.
8260350.ch: 两名修话毕竟发狠手，朝你两攻来。

8260351.en: You arrive at her dwelling, only to find that the once quiet and secluded cottage, a sanctuary from the world, is now engulfed in swirling icy wind. The cold in all directions forms a barrier, isolating the dwelling from the world.
8260351.ch: 你来到{name|B}的住处，未料平日里安静隐蔽，犹如世外之地的小筑如今卷起阵阵冰风，四方寒气便如结界隔绝一切外物。

8260352.en: As a response to your words, a cold voice echoes from the distant dwelling.
8260352.ch: 你话音才落，远方房屋传来冷冷的语声。

8260353.en: "I have achieved a breakthrough. From this moment on, I no longer need your help. Leave at once, or I shall drive you away by force."
8260353.ch: “我修为已有突破，自今而起，再也不需你帮忙。赶紧离去，否则莫怪我出手驱逐。”

8260354.en: The wind howls in miles around her dwelling like mournful roars and heart-wrenching sobs. Swirling snowstorms blind the eyes, and even the air is saturated with an overwhelming sense of despair and sorrow...
8260354.ch: {name|B}住处方圆数里，风声虎虎，恍如哀吼，又似恸哭，卷起的霜雪迷人眼目，冰寒之中充斥一股绝望悲伤之意……

8260355.en: A voice comes from the distant dwelling. "How naive. I've merely been using you all this time. Now that you're of no use, stop interfering with my cultivation. Leave at once."
8260355.ch: 远方房屋传来语声：天真，此前我不过利用你而已，如今你已无用，不要再妨碍我修炼。速速离去。

8260356.en: A voice comes from the dwelling, hollow and empty as if echoing from somewhere beyond this world...
8260356.ch: 房屋处传来语声，空空洞洞，仿佛来自天外……

8260357.en: I've warned you again and again. If you dare disturb me, I'll show no mercy! Get out!
8260357.ch: 我已一再警告，敢来打扰，绝不客气！走开！

8260358.en: The wind grows even more fierce, the cold more biting. Towering mounts of ice rise all around, transforming the area into what appears to be an imposing ice palace.
8260358.ch: 此地寒风更烈，冰寒更凛，周遭玄冰如山，四处突起，似乎已成冰宫一样的存在。

8260359.en: You press forward against the wind, but the bone-chilling cold proves impossible to withstand. Left with no other choice, you're forced to retreat temporarily.
8260359.ch: 你冒风前进，然而冰寒侵骨，根本无法抵御，万般无奈下，唯有暂时退出。眼前寒气凛冽，或需<r>增强修为，提高境界</r>才能与之相抗。

8260360.en: You attempt to force your way through the icy barrier, but the frost, snow, and ice shards carried by the frigid wind slice into you like razor-sharp blades, leaving you covered in wounds. The biting cold seeps into these cuts, spreading throughout your entire body.
8260360.ch: 你尝试强行进入这篇冰雪结界，但寒风吹来的霜雪碎冰仿佛锐刃刀片，割得你遍体鳞伤，寒气更从伤口进入，蔓延你全身上下。

8260361.en: After enduring countless hardships, you finally reach the vicinity of her dwelling. You find her slumped against the wall, her face devoid of life. As she sees you, a spark of light flashes in her dull eyes, only to be instantly replaced by utter panic.
8260361.ch: 你经历千辛万苦终于进入霜凌的住处附近。只见霜凌瘫坐在地，面目无光的依在墙边。她看见你来到这里面，原本无神的眼中瞬间亮出神采，然而这丝神采转瞬即没，却代之以万分惊惶。

8260362.en: How did you get in here?! Do you have a death wish? Get out! Get as far away as you can!
8260362.ch: 你怎么进来了！不要命吗？滚，滚得远远的！

8260363.en: Do you understand what I said? I'm on the verge of a breakthrough. I desperately need peace to meditate. If you know what's good for you, leave now.
8260363.ch: 你是没明白我说什么吗？我修为突破在即，极需静心行功，识相现在就离开。

8260364.en: You've got it all wrong. I'm the one leaving you behind now. I no longer need to search for manuals. You're of no use to me anymore.
8260364.ch: 你搞错了吧？现如今是我抛下你。我不需要找秘籍了，你已没用了。

8260365.en: I don't need to change. This is exactly what I want. I possess the most formidable ice spells in the world, and I intend to push my limit even further. You, on the other hand, are nothing but a hindrance to me.
8260365.ch: 我不需要改变，现在就是我想要的。我拥有天下间最厉害的寒冰之法，我要百尺竿头更进一步。而你，在妨碍我。

8260366.en: ...Isn't wasting away in here the best choice for everyone, including myself?
8260366.ch: ……难道烂在这里面，于人于己不都是最好的选择吗？

8260368.en: Three times is the limit. I'll say it one last time: please leave.
8260368.ch: 事不过三，我再说一遍，请你离开。

8260369.en: Hmph. I'm about to begin my cultivation now. Let me warn you: soon, the bitter cold will engulf everything for miles around. You won't be able to withstand it.
8260369.ch: 哼，我现如今要开始修炼了。我警告你，到时这方圆数里寒气横流，你可抵挡不住。

8260370.en: Seeing you remain unmoved, her expression hardens. Without further hesitation, she sits down on a meditation mat and begins her cultivation. And true to her word, as she activates her arts, frigid waves immediately begin to circulate.
8260370.ch: 霜凌看你无动于衷，脸色微微一寒，当真便在蒲团坐下行功。岂知这一运转功法，周边果然寒气四溢。

8260371.en: The severe cold invades your body. Your resistance gradually weakens. Max Vitality -10%, Health -10%
8260371.ch: 你受到严寒入侵，身体逐渐抵挡不住，气血最大值-10%，健康-10%

8260372.en: Hmph. This place will grow intolerably cold. Soon, you'll end up like those frozen corpses...
8260372.ch: 哼，此地会变得越来越严寒，你很快就会变成那些干尸一样……

8260373.en: As soon as she finishes speaking, the surrounding area grows colder. Fluffy, snow-white frost climbs up everywhere, and soon, they grow into snowflakes...
8260373.ch: 霜凌说完，周围果然变得更加寒冷。周围不断冒出雪白的毛茸茸的冰霜，这些冰霜慢慢生长，变成雪花……

8260375.en: She furrows her brow as she studies you, and the snowflakes begin to melt. Suddenly, a flash of otherworldly light gleams in her eyes. The area, which just received some warmth, is brought back into the freezing winter.
8260375.ch: 霜凌皱起眉头打量着你，周围雪花渐渐化开，但是突然间她眼中神光大涨，原本周围已经逐渐回暖，这时再次气温急降。

8260376.en: Oh no! Get out of here! Leave now, I mean it!
8260376.ch: 不好！快走！快走，我说真的。

8260377.en: Frigid winds whip up from all directions. Amid the gales, shards of frost pelt against your body.
8260377.ch: 四方寒风刮起，风浪之中，片片冰霜朝你身上刮来。

8260378.en: Get out of here! I'm not joking around...
8260378.ch: 快走！我不是与你开玩笑……

8260379.en: My cultivation is approaching perfection, and I'm on the verge of a breakthrough. You won't be able to withstand the extreme cold I'm about to unleash!
8260379.ch: 体内修为已趋圆满，眼下行将突破，你在此处绝对无法抵挡我释放的严寒！

8260380.en: You! Damn it, I'm trying my best to hold it back. Get out of here now!
8260380.ch: 你！可恶，我尽力压制，你赶快走！

8260381.en: The frigid winds subside, only to turn bone-chilling an instant later. This cycle repeats several times before the temperature around you finally plummets...
8260381.ch: 周围寒风收敛，但瞬间又转刺骨，如是变化再三，终于周围还是气温骤降……

8260382.en: Run! I can't hold it back anymore!

8260384.en: The moment you grasp her palm, an otherworldly chill penetrates your marrow. Through her energy, you sense that her efforts to suppress the overwhelming cold within her have backfired. She's teetering on the brink of Qi Deviation.
8260384.ch: 你才握住霜凌手掌，一股奇寒侵入骨髓。透过她的气机，你可以感知她为了压制体内大盈大满的寒气已遭到反噬，趋近走火入魔之势。

8260385.en: You should go. If this continues, we'll both...
8260385.ch: 你走吧，这样下去，你我都会……

8260386.en: Tears stream down her face in an endless torrent, pattering on the ground drop by drop.
8260386.ch: 霜凌泪水如注，哗啦啦的流个不停。

8260387.en: I'm so sorry... It's my fault that led you into danger...
8260387.ch: 对不起……对不起……是我害了你……

8260388.en: Upon hearing your words, she gradually calms herself, focusing on battling the icy energy within...
8260388.ch: 霜凌闻言，渐渐神宁思伏，专注于对抗体内寒气……

8260389.en: At first, you manage to stabilize her breath with all your might. But soon, the energy within her body becomes as turbulent as overturning rivers and boiling seas, making your efforts seem utterly insignificant.
8260389.ch: 开始的时候，你还能竭力稳住她的气息，但到后来她的体内彷如江翻海沸，你的力量已显得微不足道。

8260390.en: At that moment, you feel a cold breath enter your body, dispersing throughout before surging to your head. Your mind seems to elevate, merging with the very essence of the universe.
8260390.ch: 就在此时，你感觉一股冰凉的气息进入你体内，四散化开，直冲颅顶。而你的神识似乎也一并升华，与天地同化。

8260391.en: Meanwhile, an infinite joy and satisfaction wells up within you as countless fragments of memory flood your mind.
8260391.ch: 与此同时，无边喜悦与满足在你体内升起，无数片段涌入你的脑海之中。

8260392.en: You see a white-haired woman channeling her power into a fragment of primordial ice.
8260392.ch: 只见一名白发女子对着一枚玄冰释放力量，

8260393.en: Then, you see the white-haired woman fall to her knees as a distant, imposing judge pronounces the verdict...
8260393.ch: 只见白发女子跪倒地上，远处高高在上的判官抛下判令……

8260394.en: The white-haired woman drifts through the boundless cosmos, her energy slowly dissipating. Only a core of ice in her chest remains intact as she traverses multiple planes of existence before finally plummeting toward a distant continent...
8260394.ch: 白发女子飘荡于无垠宇宙之中，身上灵力不断散泄，唯有胸中一点寒冰仍在聚拢，她在众多位面之间穿行，最终坠向一处大陆……

8260395.en: As you withdraw your vision, your senses slowly sharpen. The frigid wind around you is still blowing, but it gradually subsides. The lady's pale face is now flushed with a rosy hue, and a subtle smile plays on her lips. Seeing her radiant countenance, you realize she has overcome her ordeal and achieved a successful breakthrough.
8260395.ch: 你收敛神识，知觉慢慢变得清晰。身边寒风如故，但渐已转小。面前伊人一向白皙的脸上染上嫣红，唇上也透出若有若无的笑意，观此宝相，想来她也已经度过难关，安然突破。

8260396.en: She has calmed down, and you are about to withdraw your aid. Suddenly, you feel her grasp your hand. Her eyes flutter open, and you notice her once-cold gaze shines with a warm tenderness. She fixes you with an intense, burning look.
8260396.ch: {name|B}已平静下来，你正打算收功撒手，却感觉原本对按着的手被对方轻轻握住。只见{name|B}已张开双眼，正温柔地凝视着你。

8260397.en: Would you stay with me a little longer? Just like this... for a while...
8260397.ch: 可以陪我多待一阵子吗？就这样，多待一阵子便好……

8260398.en: She offers you a gentle smile as warmth seeps into her once-cold palm. You sit in silence, hands intertwined. Occasionally, your eyes meet, and she graces you with another soft smile. The air seems filled with tenderness and joy as if a wordless understanding has blossomed between you, rendering speech unnecessary.
8260398.ch: 霜凌朝你微微一笑，原本对方冰冷的掌中慢慢传来暖意。你们就这样握着对方的手掌静静待着，有时目光相触，她便对你微微一笑。你只觉空气中充斥着温柔与喜悦，仿佛彼我之间两相知心，不需再诉诸言语。

8260399.en: You gently clasp her hand, hoping to savor this moment of tenderness alone. To your surprise, her palm also tightens around yours. You realize she has regained consciousness and is gazing at you with gentle affection.
8260399.ch: 你轻轻握住对方，正想独自享受这片刻温柔，不料霜凌手掌也缓缓收紧，与你握在一起。原来她也已经恢复知觉，正温柔地看着你。

8260400.en: Stay with me a little longer, please. I may not have the courage for this again...
8260400.ch: 多陪我一会，好吗？之后我未必再有这勇气了……

8260402.en: After that encounter, she successfully achieved a breakthrough. However, her internal energy remained unstable, requiring her to manage the cold energy alone. As a result, you two parted ways temporarily.
8260402.ch: 那次之后，霜凌成功突破境界，但体内气机未稳，仍需独自应付寒气，因此你两暂时分别。

8260403.en: Upon your next visit, you find her gazing at distant mountains, her face etched with worry. She seems lost in thought, grappling with some complex, unsolvable problem.
8260403.ch: 再次造访时，却见伊人面朝远山，脸容愁苦，似乎正想着什么复杂难解之事。

8260404.en: You're here. Thank you for what you did last time. If not for your help, I might have lost control, and... my core could have ruptured; I would have died from it...
8260404.ch: 你来了，上次的事多谢你，若非你帮忙，也许我会失控，会内府炸裂而死……

8260405.en: At that moment... as my essence returned to its true form and I regained control for me, I felt our minds merge. I glimpsed fragments of your past, and I assume you saw parts of mine as well...
8260405.ch: 当时……神气归真，重掌万机之际，我感觉到我与你的神识似乎交融在一起。我看到了一些你的事，而想必你也看到了一些我的事……

8260406.en: Is there... anything you'd like to know?

8260407.en: Yes, and no. That was who I used to be. It was me in another higher dimensional plane—what you would call the Upper Realm.
8260407.ch: 是，也不是。那是往昔的我。曾经在其他高维位面的我，亦即你们所说的“上界”。

8260408.en: Long ago, the universe teemed with countless realms. In one of these, the plane you call the Upper Realm, I served as an official tasked with managing the Ice Essences.
8260408.ch: 昔日，宇宙中充斥无数位面，我在其中一个你们称之为上界的位面中任职女官，专司管理冰魄。

8260409.en: Due to my management of these Ice Essences and my constant companionship with the cold, the denizens there called me Lady Frostdweller. That white-haired woman you saw in the vision... was me.
8260409.ch: 由于我长久管理这些冰魄，与寒冰为伍，上界之人便称我为栖寒仙子，亦即你看见的那名白发女子……

8260410.en: The Ice Essences were used to preserve important souls. One day, an exceptionally powerful soul was entrusted to me. In my arrogance, I believed I could use my techniques to crystallize it into an Ice Essence.
8260410.ch: 冰魄用于保存重要魂灵。当时交到我手中的一个魂魄力量十分强大，我自以为能够以冰封之法将其凝成冰魄。

8260411.en: However, the soul broke free from the Ice Essence and triggered a spiritual blast. This destroyed my entire department. For my mismanagement, I was imprisoned.
8260411.ch: 岂知最后魂灵攻破冰魄发生灵爆，致司所损毁，我因管理失当遭囚。

8260412.en: After forty-nine days of deliberation, the council deemed my crime unforgivable. They banished me from that plane, exiling me to the Lower Realm...
8260412.ch: 后经七七四十九日，众使认为我罪不可恕，因此将我逐出位面，贬往下界……

8260413.en: After my expulsion from the Upper Realm, they feared I might find a way to return. So, they stripped me of all my powers before casting me into the boundless universe.
8260413.ch: 我被逐出“上界”后，他们防我找到方法暗中回归，因此将我所有法力尽数剥离，这才将我流放于无垠宇宙之中，

8260414.en: As I drifted through that vast expanse, I thought my energy would dissipate and my soul would dissolve into the void. Unexpectedly, as I passed by a realm, a formidable force took hold of me.
8260414.ch: 漂浮在那片广漠无边的空间之际，我以为我的灵力会就此散尽，与虚空同化。未料我经过一片位面之际，却遭到一股强大的力量吸引。

8260415.en: Finally, before my energy vanished, I entered a realm where I managed to preserve my physical form.
8260415.ch: 终于，在我灵力完全消散之前，我来到了一个位面之中，最终得以保存形体。

8260416.en: In the Upper Realm, I cultivated the arts of ice, and, throughout my life, I was surrounded by Ice Essences. Cold currents have intertwined within me for so long that the ice and I have become one and the same...
8260416.ch: 我于上界修炼寒冰之法，终此一生又与冰魄为伍，体内寒流交织，早已不分彼我……

8260417.en: The officials who exiled me initially intended to strip everything away. However, they reconsidered and realized that if I somehow regained my energy and found a way to return to the Upper Realm again, their punishment would be meaningless.
8260417.ch: 当时贬谪我的官使，原想将一切都剥离净尽，后又转念一想，万一我得了机缘重修灵力跃迁位面，再回上界，此番惩戒便失去效用了。

8260418.en: So they left me with my cold energy. This way, even if I managed to survive, I would be shunned by others in the Lower Realm and be doomed to eternal solitude...
8260418.ch: 因此他们保留了我的寒气，这样一来，即使我得了机缘保住了性命，在下界之中也会遭到旁人嫌弃，永远孤独一人……

8260419.en: With no one willing to help me, returning to the Upper Realm became an almost insurmountable challenge.
8260419.ch: 没人愿意帮助我，我要重回上界，便难上加难了。

8260420.en: The realm I came from was a world of ice and snow, distant like the legendary palace on the Moon. Everyone there was cold and emotionless, merely performing their assigned duties.
8260420.ch: 我所在的那个上界是一个冰雪世界，整一个广寒宫似的。所有人都冷冷的，没有一丝情绪，只是各司其职。

8260421.en: But here is different. It's more... complex. While it harbors the cruelest of hearts, it also nurtures the warmest of kindness. I've grown to love this place sincerely.
8260421.ch: 但八荒不同，这里更为……复杂。固然有最冷酷的人心，但也有最温暖的人情。我由衷地喜欢上这里。

8260422.en: I wanted to eradicate the cold energy from my body and live a normal life in this world. So I figured out the principles about the energy here and began searching for manuals, hoping to use them to rid myself of the cold within me.
8260422.ch: 我想彻底排除体内的寒气，在这片地方之中好好生活。因此我慢慢了解八荒的灵力原理，开始寻找秘籍进行修炼，希望借此排除体内寒气。

8260423.en: Only by purging the icy energy from my body could I become a "normal" person, right?
8260423.ch: 只有排除了体内的寒气，我才能成为一个“正常”人吧？

8260424.en: I chose to dwell in the Everfrost for two reasons: firstly, to focus on my cultivation in peace, and secondly, to avoid harming others.
8260424.ch: 我在隐秘荒凉的地方栖身，一则是要静心修炼，二则是为了不必伤害旁人。

8260425.en: As you can see, the icy energy is an inseparable part of me. The slightest leakage of it can affect those around me. Before I met you, I had already hurt many people.
8260425.ch: 如你所见，寒气与我为一体。稍不注意，就会影响旁人，在认识你之前，我已经伤及很多人。

8260426.en: Anyone who knows of me sees me as some kind of spectral entity. And I, too, wish to avoid hurting others.
8260426.ch: 但凡知道我的，都当我是鬼魅一般的存在。而我也不想伤害旁人。

8260427.en: The Everfrost is a desolate, bitterly cold place. My presence doesn't make it any colder, nor would my absence make it any warmer.
8260427.ch: 留在荒僻之地，恰恰不会害到旁人，这就很好……

8260428.en: After what happened, I've come to realize that I can never rid myself of this coldness. I can't change anything. This is simply my fate.
8260428.ch: 经此一事，我也知道，已经无法摆脱体内寒气，无法改变任何事，这就是我的命。

8260429.en: I'm not being defeatist. We've made our efforts, but everything has come to naught.
8260429.ch: 这不是泄气话，我们已经做出过努力，而且一切都已付诸东流。

8260430.en: I'm telling you all this in hopes that you won't come back anymore. You can't help me.
8260430.ch: 告诉你这些，仅仅是希望你以后不要再来了，你帮不了我。

8260431.en: The past cannot be changed, and my future is already set in stone. No matter how far I look, I see no new horizons...
8260431.ch: 过往固然无法改变，面前的命运亦早有定数。看得再远，也不会有新的景象……

8260432.en: So-called defiance of fate is nothing but wishful thinking. What's set cannot be changed. If a few pretty words could rewrite our destiny, there would be no insurmountable challenges in this world.
8260432.ch: 所谓不认命，终究一厢情愿罢了。既定之事无可更改。若说几句漂亮话就能逆天改命，天下便再无难事了。

8260433.en: No matter how hard I try, I can only tend to this small patch of existence. I've finally come to terms with it—this Everfrost is my true home.
8260433.ch: 我再努力，也只能守着眼前这一亩三分地。我算是明白了，眼前这片荒无人烟的地方就是我的归宿。

8260434.en: You're right, this is who I am. I can't despise myself, but I can prevent others from despising me.
8260434.ch: 你说得不错，这就是我。我无法嫌弃自己，但我可以避免旁人嫌弃我。

8260435.en: What good could there possibly be in me? Good enough to be constantly hunted and pursued by the cultivators of Yun Mo?
8260435.ch: 我能有什么好？好到被云陌州修士一直追杀围捕？

8260436.en: That might work for ordinary people; but for someone like me? It's pointless.
8260436.ch: 这话对一般人说还好，但对我说，就犯不着了。

8260437.en: Then I have no choice but to leave this place and go somewhere you can't find me.
8260437.ch: 那我只有离开此地，去你找不到的地方。

8260438.en: There's so much going on in the world; you'll forget about me sooner or later. Besides, grand promises are often made in the heat of the moment. I won't take them seriously.
8260438.ch: 天下事这么多，你早晚会忘了的。而且豪言壮语，多为一时热情而发，我也不会当真。

8260439.en: I'm speaking to you in all seriousness, yet you jest with me. You're neither the cage of heaven and earth nor the grand cosmos, so how can you claim I can't escape you?
8260439.ch: 我认认真真的跟你说话，你却与我玩笑。你不是天地樊笼，更非宇宙大道，何来逃不出这一说？

8260441.en: As you speak, her eyes well up with tears. She suddenly leans against the outer wall of the dwelling, unable to hold back her sobs.
8260441.ch: 你正说着，霜凌已是泪眼婆娑，她一把扶着身边房子外墙，忍不住便哭了出来。

8260442.en: I've tried so hard, I really have. But after all these years, I still can't see an end to this struggle.
8260442.ch: 我都已经努力过了，我真的已经努力过了。可是这么多年过去了，就没见着到头的日子。

8260443.en: I can't go on like this forever. I'll end up... depending on others... I can't bear it anymore...
8260443.ch: 一直这样下去，我会受不了的。我会忍不住依赖……依赖旁人……我已经受不了了……

8260444.en: But I can't harm others just because I can't bear it myself. You don't understand any of this, you don't understand at all! You're only here to disrupt everything!
8260444.ch: 可我不能因为自己受不了就去害了旁人，这些你都不懂，你都不懂！你只会来打岔！

8260445.en: Every time I try to speak seriously, you interrupt me!
8260445.ch: 但凡我硬起心肠说的，你都打岔！

8260446.en: Hearing your words, her eyes overflow with tears. She rushes into your arms, sobbing uncontrollably. She clings to you tightly and weeps as if years of pent-up sorrow are finally being released through her tears.
8260446.ch: 霜凌听了你这话，那眼睛之中泪水更是汹涌而出，她一把扑了过来投到你怀中，放声痛哭。她紧紧抱着你，似乎要把所有的委屈全部哭了出来。

8260447.en: A ray of sunlight pierces through the heavy clouds and warms the ground. The icicles on the house begin to melt into tiny droplets, falling to the earth with gentle pitter-patters.
8260447.ch: 此时空中天光刺破重云，落在地面，屋旁冰霜消解，化作点滴水珠，落在地上，发出叮咚的响。

8260448.en: Hey, did you hear? That pretty girl said she'd marry whoever opens a mystic realm for her!
8260448.ch: 我看见那名少女身上怀有龙鳞。

8260449.en: What? Then let's try our luck too! We can't let her end up with some ugly guy. It'd be like a diamond in a dunghill!
8260449.ch: 你没看错吧？龙鳞？以之炼宝，能成上好的饰物的龙鳞？

8260450.en: How come I've never heard of this? Besides, that girl isn't just a pretty face—she's sharp as a tack. She doesn't need anyone's help. It may be only a story.
8260450.ch: 怎可能看错？此等异物，绝无仅有。你说怎么办？

8260451.en: They say the mystic realm is just nearby, shining bright and brimming with Qi! Who cares if it's true or not? Let's go and check it!
8260451.ch: 将那女的解决了，拿下龙鳞。快走，这就跟上那少女。

8260452.ch: 嘿嘿，你还是跟以前一样心狠手辣啊。我仿佛都能看见那少女惨呼痛哭的样子了。

8260453.en: Ahead lies the mystic realm, exuding waves of Qi. Upon closer inspection, you find its barrier has already been torn. With just a bit more effort to widen the entrance, you'll be able to venture inside.
8260453.ch: 前方秘境洞天，透出阵阵灵气，仔细查看，可见界璧已经撕裂，正待进一步拓宽入口便能进入探索。

8260454.en: As the barrier widens, a woman suddenly appears just as you're about to step inside.
8260454.ch: 秘境洞天的界壁慢慢被拓宽开启，眼看便能进入探索，此时一名女子突然现身。

8260455.en: Hey, friend, I've been watching you for a while. Hold on! I discovered this mystic realm, and you can't enter it right now!
8260455.ch: 朋友，我留意你很久了。等等，这个洞天是我发现的，目前你不能进去！

8260456.en: Tsk, fine! How about exploring together?
8260456.ch: 啧，没办法！这样吧，咱们一起进去探索。

8260457.en: Your world is a mess, and this place might be crawling with all sorts of monsters, who knows? We'd better watch each other's backs, right?
8260457.ch: 你们八荒乌烟瘴气的，没准里面都是妖魔鬼怪，咱们正好互相照应，对吧？

8260458.en: Hey, how can you be so unreasonable? If I hadn't discovered this mystic realm, you wouldn't even be able to widen the entrance!
8260458.ch: 喂，你怎么不讲理？如果不是我发现了这处洞天，你也就无法拓宽入口！

8260459.en: How about this? We both make a compromise. Let's explore together. It might be teeming with monsters, and we can watch each other's backs!
8260459.ch: 这样吧，咱们一人退一步，你我一起进去探索，指不定里面充斥妖怪，我们可以互相照应呢！

8260460.en: Whoa, hold on! That's not quite right either! You're making me sound like the unreasonable one here!
8260460.ch: 哎哎！你这么说也不对哈！说得好像是我蛮不讲理一般！

8260461.en: What I mean is, let's explore together!
8260461.ch: 我的意思是，我们一起进去探索！

8260462.en: You don't believe me? Most cultivators are dull-witted, they wouldn't have noticed it.
8260462.ch: 你不相信？一般修仙者那么迟钝，肯定发现不了啊。

8260463.en: How about this? We explore this mystic realm together, and then I'll find you another one. What do you say?
8260463.ch: 这样吧，咱们先把眼前的秘境探索一番，我立即给你找到另外一座，你看怎样？

8260464.en: Hit the nail on the head, didn't I? Makes perfect sense, right? Hehe!
8260464.ch: 一语中的，言之有理吧？嘿嘿！

8260465.en: Hehe, you're making it sound like I'm trying to trick you into being my muscle or something.
8260465.ch: 嘻嘻，你怎么说得好像我是来骗你入局，然后给我当打手一样。

8260466.en: Tsk, forget it! Go in if you want, you're acting like I'm begging you! I can't be bothered to waste a breath on you.
8260466.ch: 切，拉倒，你爱进你进，搞得好像我在求你一样！本姑娘懒得跟你废话。

8260467.en: The woman watches eagerly as you emerge from inside. Only then does she let out a huff and turn to leave.
8260467.ch: 面前女子巴巴的看你从里面出来，这才哼的一声转身离去。

8260468.en: Good thing I brought along someone who can fight! Otherwise, with all these monsters, it would've been a real hassle!
8260468.ch: 幸好拉了个能打的，不然这么多怪物，动起手来可得费些功夫呢！

8260469.en: Oh! I mean this worked out great! We make a good team, complementing each other's strengths, right?
8260469.ch: 呀，我的意思是这样挺好的，咱们合作愉快互补不足哈！

8260470.en: Alright, exploration's done. Time to divvy up the spoils!
8260470.ch: 好了，探索完了，该分赃了！

8260471.en: Oh, come on! I just mean sharing the rewards! You know, my family always taught me to be prim and proper and speak formally, and so on. Those stuffy nonsense are so boring! And actually, I know quite a bit of your cultivators' slang!
8260471.ch: 哎呀，就是分享成果啦！以前我的家人总是教我规行矩步啊，说话正经说啊，文邹邹的，忒没意思。我跟你说，你们修仙者的黑话我懂不少哦！

8260472.en: So... split it half and half? Oh, wait! I'm just a little lady, so I should get the smaller share. You're the big shot, so you take the larger portion. That settles it!
8260472.ch: 咱们……对半分？哎呀，我是小姑娘我拿小份，你是大朋友你拿大份，就这么定吧！

8260473.en: Oh? Sure! Take it, take it all!

8260474.en: Strange, did I forget something? Father and Minister Turtle taught me it should be like this, right?
8260474.ch: 怪了，还差个啥呢？父王和龟丞相教的应该是这样没错啊……

8260475.en: Ao Yao stands with her hands clasped behind her back, facing distant mountains. She seems to be examining the local terrain.
8260475.ch: 交出龙鳞，否则叫你生死两难！

8260476.en: Hey, perfect timing! Not to brag, but ever since I learned the art of perceiving hidden realms from the Dragon Clan of the East Sea, I've been able to open nearby mystic realms without fail.
8260476.ch: 你这家伙净会缠夹不清，我不知道什么龙鳞不龙鳞的，我走了，别跟着我啊。

8260477.en: Get me some Wind Essence Bamboo, and I'll open this mystic realm right away. Who knows? We might find some sweet loot inside. So, wanna team up?
8260477.ch: 敖瑶气鼓鼓的闪入面前一个空间裂隙，那修士穷追不舍，也冲入其中。

8260478.en: Well, aren't you quick on your feet!
8260478.ch: 咦，是你？进来干嘛？这里面可不太平。来了！

8260479.en: Ao Yao forms a hand seal and is about to cast a spell. Your vision blurs for a moment; the figure beside you seems to transform from a charming girl into an azure dragon. As you look closer, the illusion fades, and you find the entrance to the mystic realm has opened before you.
8260479.ch: 敖瑶捏个指诀准备施法，你感觉眼前微微一花，身边之人仿佛从一个娇俏少女变成青龙，你再细看时幻觉散去，她已出手与妖兽战作一团，此时一名修士悍然突入，直取前方少女，面前战况顿时大乱。

8260480.ch: 哎呀，快来帮忙！快来帮忙！

8260481.en: Quite the haul, huh? Hehe, not too shabby teaming up with me, right?
8260481.ch: 好险，应该甩掉那家伙了吧？

8260482.en: Uh... I mean I just happened to learn this technique from the Dragon Clan by chance!

8260483.en: Well... It's not that I don't want to teach you. It's just that this secret technique requires a rather unique physique to learn and master.
8260483.ch: 噢，那个人啊，他不知道跑到哪去了。老是跟着我，是个十足的坏蛋呢。

8260484.en: Does a girl like me need any other reason? I just want to see things I've never seen before and explore unknown places!
8260484.ch: 龙鳞不就是龙身上的鳞片吗？据说是宝物，修士们都爱你争我夺的。

8260485.en: Stick with me, kid, and you won't miss out on the good stuff!
8260485.ch: 嘿嘿，没事我先走啦。咳咳，今天多谢你帮忙啦！

8260487.en: Oh, you're here! Don't go anywhere, okay?
8260487.ch: 远方突然传来一声尖叫，听声音似乎是上回那少女敖瑶所发。

8260488.en: Forget treasure hunting, someone's in mortal danger!
8260488.ch: 前方敖瑶被一名修士挟持，她竭力挣扎，企图摆脱对方。

8260489.en: Here's the deal: I found a mystic realm and was trying everything to open it. Alright, I admit I wanted to ask for your help.
8260489.ch: 还想逃到洞天里面避难是吧？你害死我同伴的账该算一算了！乖乖将鳞片交出，我让你少受点痛苦。

8260490.en: But that's not the main issue. The thing is, two guys were tailing me. While I was wondering where to find you, they snuck up on the mystic realm.
8260490.ch: 什么计较！分明是你贪图那龙鳞，害死了同伴，还反过来怪我！

8260491.en: The mystic realm had just opened and was still unstable. Those fools rushed in... and boom! An energy explosion. One guy took it head-on and got blown to... well, I reckon his head flew all the way to...
8260491.ch: 是啊！同伴我都对付了，还会顾惜你吗？快将龙鳞交出来！

8260492.en: Let's not dwell on that. There's another guy who got sucked inside. The one blown up is a goner, but we might still save the other.
8260492.ch: 是啊！同伴你都对付了！还会顾惜我吗？交不交出来你都要狠很折磨我的。

8260493.en: If we can save him, shouldn't we give it a shot?
8260493.ch: 哼，不知死活的东西，敬酒不吃吃罚酒！

8260494.en: Come on, the guy's in danger. How can he be harboring evil at a time like this?
8260494.ch: 就是啊，我还小，喝什么酒呢？不对！呸！再放肆本姑娘不跟你客气了啊！

8260495.en: Hurry, hurry! Go get some Spirit Stones. I'll stabilize the entrance to the mystic realm!
8260495.ch: 救我！这家伙老是给我说什么龙鳞，我不知道他在说什么！

8260496.en: Ao Yao casts a spell and melts the Spirit Stones into a strange ring on the ground. The fluctuating entrance to the mystic realm stabilizes in an instant.

8260497.en: Let's hurry inside and save him.
8260497.ch: 喂喂，君子动口不动手，你这不但动嘴，还动手动脚，我不跟你客气了啊！

8260498.en: As you leave the mystic realm, the cultivator unexpectedly makes his move, taking Ao Yao hostage...
8260498.ch: 你们离开洞天，没想到那名修士突然出手挟持敖瑶……

8260499.en: You! Hand over everything you just took from inside!
8260499.ch: 你！把刚进去拿了的东西交出来！

8260500.en: Okay, okay! It's all yours, every bit of it.

8260501.en: Good, I've got it all now. You demon, it's time we settle the score for my friend's death!
8260501.ch: 我说的是龙鳞，不是这些乱七八糟的。

8260502.en: No, wait! Your friend brought this on himself. I warned him not to go in!

8260503.en: I saw it with my own eyes! You turned into a massive, vicious serpent. You were trying to kill me! I panicked and had no choice...

8260504.en: What? Serpent? Are you blind? That was clearly... Oh, come on, let me go first. We're civilized folks here, aren't we? Let's talk this out instead of resorting to violence!
8260504.ch: 什么！蛇？你眼瞎了吧？那明明是……哎呀，你先放开我，咱们都是斯文人，动口不动手！

8260505.en: You've been deceived by this demon, haven't you?
8260505.ch: 道友，你是受了这妖怪蒙骗吧！

8260506.en: Whoa there! I'll count to three, then I'm out of here. Let's take a deep breath and talk this through, okay?
8260506.ch: 哎呀，我数三下，先脱身了，咱们冷静一下，好好说话！

8260507.en: Count to three? I'll end your life right now!
8260507.ch: 还数三下？我立刻就要了你的命！

8260508.en: The cultivator raises his hand and swings at Ao Yao's head. In that critical moment, Ao Yao's body dissolves into a wisp of smoke, slipping free from his grasp and rushing toward you.
8260508.ch: 那修士手起手落，挥往敖瑶头顶，危急之际敖瑶身化青烟脱离束缚，朝你这边奔来。

8260509.en: The cultivator charges toward Ao Yao, but unexpectedly, the mystic realm behind him suddenly produces a powerful suction, pulling him in instead...
8260509.ch: 那名修士朝敖瑶冲了过来，只没想后面洞天突然吸力泄出，竟将那名修士吸了进去……

8260510.en: Oh, dear... We couldn't save him after all, and that's what we got from our good deeds! Hey, take these as a consolation.
8260510.ch: 哎呀……得救了！谢谢你哈！来来来，这些个给你。都是好东西吧？

8260511.en: Seeing Ao Yao slip from his grasp, the cultivator hastily launches an attack at the center of her back.
8260511.ch: 那名修士眼看敖瑶脱离掌控，忙发出灵力攻向敖瑶背心。

8260512.en: You shatter the ring with your power, and unexpectedly, a surge of energy rushes out from the mystic realm's entrance. A deafening boom echoes as massive plumes of smoke billow skyward. Debris from the explosion scatters in all directions, hurtling toward the heavens.
8260512.ch: 你发出灵力阻挡修士前行，同时一声轰鸣，大朵烟云冲天而起，爆炸后的碎片四散冲天。

8260513.en: Oh my... His head's taking a trip to Tian Yuan Mountain too... Here, take these as a souvenir.
8260513.ch: 哎呀……这洞天极不稳定，他……应该被炸飞了吧？

8260514.en: Demon? What demon? Do I look like a demon to you? That guy must've hit his head when he fell in there.
8260514.ch: 什么妖？你看我哪里像妖！那家伙撞到脑袋了吧。

8260515.en: Oh? These little trinkets might be useful to you, right? I've noticed cultivators here are always on the hunt for these Heaven and Earth Treasures. After all that trouble, you deserve some perks, don't you? Hehe.
8260515.ch: 天地良心，我绝对没拿旁人的东西！老说什么龙鳞龙鳞，说得好像那是他们的东西一样，他们就是一伙强盗！

8260516.en: Well, today was a bit of a letdown. Next time, we'll have to find another mystic realm to play in!

8260517.en: As Ao Yao strolls away, she suddenly halts. Veins bulge across her face for a split second before vanishing without a trace. Confusion flickers in her eyes as she gently touches her cheek, finding nothing amiss. Puzzled, she resumes her departure...
8260517.ch: 敖瑶正漫步离去，但她突然站定，脸上透出条条青筋，但瞬间又恢复原状。她脸上透出疑惑之色，便伸手抹摸了摸脸颊，但抚摸下别无异状，便又举步离去……

8260518.en: Hey, hey! I've found a mystic realm, and there's a beautiful lady inside. Get this—she's wearing red robes! Wanna go check it out together?
8260518.ch: 小姑娘，我几位朋友的仇该了一下了。

8260519.en: Hehe, let's see if we can charm that red-robed beauty!
8260519.ch: 你们这些修士怎么就死脑筋爱抢别人的东西呢，真是的！就在前面，别说我没警告你，里面肯定有什么大妖，不安全的！

8260520.en: Ao Yao points out the location of the mystic realm. Its entrance has already opened, revealing a parched and cracked landscape within—a place of utter desolation.
8260520.ch: 在洞天之中？你可别动什么坏心思！不然我叫你变成没手没脚的怪物！

8260522.ch: 咦，是你！快走快走！那家伙被妖兽逮住了！

8260524.en: Well, it may be a demon, but isn't it still kinda cute? Hehe... Though I gotta say, this is quite a surprise. Alright, let's fight it first!
8260524.ch: 哈哈，那家伙一直让我交出宝物，我没办法只好把他引进来让鲮鱼精抓住他，没想到他那么不济事，鲮鱼精一下就把他打倒追上来了！

8260526.en: After defeating your opponent, the rocky earth suddenly splits open, gushing forth countless clear springs. In the blink of an eye, the realm becomes a lake. Before you is a surface so still and mirror-like that it could reflect even the finest hair.
8260526.ch: 妖物消亡后，山石土地崩裂，喷出大量清泉，只眨眼间便成了个水泽之国，面前水平如镜，可鉴人毛发。

8260527.en: After watching for a while, Ao Yao begins searching for something along the shore. Occasionally, she tosses pearls and other treasures into the lake, sending delicate ripples across the surface.
8260527.ch: 敖瑶看了一会周围景色便开始在干岸上四处搜索着什么，偶尔将一些珍珠宝物抛入湖面，荡开点点涟漪。

8260528.en: However, upon the emerald waves, Ao Yao's reflection is far from human. The creature has a vicious maw; its head is adorned with piercing eyes, sharp horns, and twisted whiskers. It is a visage more akin to some terrible monster.
8260528.ch: 然而碧波之上，却可见敖瑶倒影不类人形，更像是什么妖物。

8260529.en: But as you lean in for a closer look, the ripples subside. The lake's surface returns to a mirror-like calm, once again reflecting only Ao Yao's enchanting face.
8260529.ch: 你正想细看，然而水波已然平复，湖面碧水如镜，呈现的还是敖瑶那俏丽的容貌。

8260530.en: Oh my, why are you just standing there like a dummy? Here, take these! See? You can find plenty of good stuff with just a quick look around. Come on, let's get going! That Carpia must've come to this mystic realm to absorb Qi. Sheesh, the nerve of it!
8260530.ch: 嘿嘿，干嘛傻站着？来，给你！多谢你几次相救，喂喂，别看是个小玩意，这可是我亲手做的，不要随便扔了！对了，我从一只龙马身上悟出一套功法，挺好玩的，一并教给你了，能让修士灵光反照智珠在握，可厉害了。

8260531.en: Oh, it's you! Been working hard on your cultivation lately?
8260531.ch: 咦，是你啊？最近有在努力修炼吗？

8260532.en: Working hard on cultivation? That's where you're going wrong! Listen, I've got a book at home titled "Fight Through the Heavens." It's full of stories about the most powerful cultivators.
8260532.ch: 努力修炼就不对了嘛！我跟你说。我家里有本书叫《修士的自我修养》，里面都记载了许多大能轶事。

8260533.en: You know what? None of those big shots got where they are through diligent cultivation. They all had some crazy adventures that led to a major breakthrough.
8260533.ch: 那些大能啊，都是得了什么福缘和奇遇从而突破境界的。

8260534.en: So, how about coming with me to explore a mystic realm? Who knows, you might stumble upon an incredible adventure too! I'll be waiting for you over there. Don't forget to show up!
8260534.ch: 所以你要不要跟我走一遭，去探探秘境，没准能有什么奇遇呢？我在那边等你！要来噢！

8260535.en: Well? Wanna go in? From experience, I'd say there might be all sorts of monsters in there, big and small. Not to mention some cultivators with less-than-noble intentions.
8260535.ch: 怎样？要不要进去？依经验看，里面指不定就是什么大妖小妖，还有什么心怀叵测的修士之类的。

8260536.en: You enter the realm, but contrary to expectations, there are no monsters here. Instead, you're surrounded by breathtaking scenery. This place is truly a hidden gem.
8260536.ch: 你进入后发现此地并无妖物，乃是一处风景优美的地方。

8260537.en: Hehe, pretty nice place, huh? I put quite a bit of effort into this one, you know.
8260537.ch: 嘿嘿，这个地方不错吧？可是花了我好些心思呢。

8260538.en: I took care of all the monsters here! It was a piece of cake!
8260538.ch: 我都将这里面的妖怪搞定了！小菜一碟！

8260539.en: Oh my, you're actually worried about me? Well, I guess my efforts weren't wasted after all. I found this nice spot just for you to unwind a bit, you know.
8260539.ch: 哎呀，还知道关心我，不枉我给你找了个好地方，让你散散心呢。

8260540.en: Cultivating all day long? You'll drive yourself crazy! Come on, people need to do other things to keep balance in life. Don't you agree?
8260540.ch: 一天到晚修炼，人都要修傻了。人么，总得干点什么其他的调剂一下啊，你说是吧？

8260541.en: Let me tell you something—this place wasn't always like this. It's a highly malleable mystic realm, you see. After I chased out all the monsters, I started remodeling it after a beautiful place I know. I gave it a complete makeover, inside and out.
8260541.ch: 我跟你说，这个地方本来不是这样的。但这是个十分容易塑造的洞天，我将里面的妖怪全部赶走以后就开始依着个漂亮的地方，里里外外翻修了一遍。

8260542.en: Uh... what beautiful place? Well, it's somewhere that you humans... well, cultivators, really like to visit. You know, the kind of place where people often go to admire flowers, gaze at the moon, chat, and drink.
8260542.ch: 呃……什么漂亮的地方……反正是你们人类，不，反正是你们这些修士很喜欢去的。经常在这赏花赏月，聊天喝酒。

8260543.en: Tsk! Is treasure all you can think about? Fine, fine, here you go! Way to ruin the mood, killjoy!
8260543.ch: 呸，你心里就惦记着宝物吗？给你给你，扫兴的家伙！

8260544.en: Hehe, now that's more like it!

8260545.en: What to do with Ao Yao now...

8260546.en: You engage Ao Yao in a game of go, only to discover her skills are far beyond yours. You're completely outmatched. She watches you with a gentle smile, waiting for your next move.
8260546.ch: 你与敖瑶手谈一局，但发现她棋艺十分高超，你根本无法招架。她笑吟吟的看着，静待你下一步举动。

8260547.en: I came here today to unwind. Getting all competitive and obsessed with winning or losing would only add to my stress. Besides, wouldn't that be missing the point entirely?
8260547.ch: 今天来到这里，是为了放松放松，如果激起斗心，分个胜负，只有徒增烦恼。而且，这不是本末倒置吗？

8260548.en: You know what? I'm not actually that interested in playing Go. But I've been studying a particular subject lately, and it just happens to apply to the game too. That's the only reason I can hold my own against you.
8260548.ch: 我跟你说，其实我对棋道没什么兴趣，不过近日研究一门学问，触类旁通，融于棋道，这才能够和你分庭抗礼。

8260549.en: Ao Yao begins to share some profound wisdom with you. While you don't fully grasp it all, you feel a spark of insight in your heart. Seeing that you've gained some understanding, Ao Yao gracefully resigns the game. She stands up and turns her attention to the surrounding scenery.
8260549.ch: 敖瑶开始和你说一些高深的道理，你似懂非懂，然则有悟于心。敖瑶看你颇有感悟，便投子认输，站了起来观看周围景致。

8260550.en: Debate, you say? Alright then, I'll ask you something!

8260552.en: Pfft! I thought you'd go all poetic on me, saying something like, "Lo and behold! Distant mountains painted emerald, waters clear as jade. A secluded paradise, a masterpiece of Nature's design!"
8260552.ch: 噗呲，我还以为你会说，此间远山如黛，水若缥碧，幽幽落落，乃为鬼斧神工之人间形胜之类呢。

8260553.en: See? Even a rough character like me can spout such flowery nonsense. I'd say that earns me a win for this round, don't you think?
8260553.ch: 你看我这样粗鲁，都能说出这文邹邹的话来，这局怎么也得算我赢了吧？

8260554.en: Oh my, I love to hear that! Alright, you win this round.
8260554.ch: 哎呀，本姑娘爱听这话！好，这局算你赢了。

8260555.en: Pff! W-what do you mean, a rendezvous spot for lovers?! You're talking nonsense! You lose this round!
8260555.ch: 呸！什、什么情侣相会之地！你胡说八道，这局你输！

8260556.en: Let me ask you another question. If your best friend came from somewhere else, would you be willing to visit them after you attained the Tao and ascended?
8260556.ch: 我再问你，如果你的挚友来自其他地方，你得道飞升后愿意去找他玩吗？

8260557.en: Hmm, you've struck a chord with me there. I think if that day ever comes, I'd go through hell and high water to reunite with my good friends too.
8260557.ch: 唔，说到我的心坎儿去了。我想若是有这么一天，我也会费劲千辛万苦，与好朋友再次相聚吧。

8260558.en: You're such a cautious one, aren't you? I bet you never make promises you can't keep!
8260558.ch: 你这家伙，好谨慎！绝不会承诺做不到的事情吧！

8260559.en: Indeed, not everything is within our control. You cultivators claim to master your own fate. And yet, the universe is infinite in its forms that encompass all. In the unseen tapestry of existence, everything and everyone already has their own karmic connections. All encounters and circumstances are, in fact, predetermined.
8260559.ch: 是呢，万事不由人，你们修仙者，说是说掌握自己命运。然则大化无穷，涵养一切。冥冥之中，万事万物已经有了自己的因缘。一切际会，更是早定。

8260560.en: Hmm, the deepest love burns our lives fastest, and if we push too hard, we'll only shame ourselves. If pouring your heart out only means ending up being hurt, maybe it's better to be alone from the start. Sure, you might feel a bit lonely, but at least you won't have to deal with that gut-wrenching heartbreak, right?
8260560.ch: 嗯，情深不寿，强极则辱。与其付出真情，最后还受了伤，还不如打开始就自己一个。最后可能会寂寞了些，但起码不至于撕心裂肺的伤心难过啊。

8260561.en: Oh my, let's wrap up our little philosophical debate here. How about we go somewhere else for a change of pace?
8260561.ch: 哎呀，咱们的歪道先论到这里，再去别的地方玩玩吧？

8260562.en: Hehe, as it happens, I have a pot of exquisite tea with me. It's called Dragon's Essence. Legend has it that an ancient azure dragon refined its own saliva nine times and made it nectar beneath its tongue. The nectar then nurtured a tea tree; its leaves became this brew.
8260562.ch: 嘿嘿，恰好我有一壶上等的茶茗。此茗名为龙涎，据传乃是远古龙涎滋养仙草而成。

8260563.en: The tea has a blue-green hue and feels icy cold on the tongue, carrying the fragrance of osmanthus and orchid. Its aftertaste develops a hint of rice liquor, while a subtle lychee sweetness lingers in the nose. Drinking it reinforces your inner Qi, and it's a treasure that cultivators crave.
8260563.ch: 其茶色青碧，入口冰凉，有桂兰之香，九转回味后，舌底则生酒酿之气，鼻后却微闻荔枝甘甜。饮之可固五脏灵气，乃修士梦寐以求的好物。

8260564.en: As you sip the tea, its sweet essence dissolves instantly upon entering your body. It then cycles through you, becoming an ethereal mist that permeates your entire being. A wave of comfort washes over you as the energy courses into every bone and sinew.
8260564.ch: 你将饮下茶汤，甘美的汁液入体即化，旋而九转体内，化为一丝氤氲，穿行百骸，让你感觉十分舒适。

8260565.en: Hmm, it's a shame I only have this one pot. We can't really enjoy ourselves. But you know, I tend to get tea-drunk, so I'll just have a taste to satisfy my craving. The rest is all yours.
8260565.ch: 唔，可惜身边就这么一壶，不能开怀畅饮。不过我会醉茶，尝一些尽兴就算了，剩下的都给你吧。

8260567.en: Sure, flowers are beautiful, but they'll wither in the end. Good things only last for a moment, and then it's a long stretch of unhappiness.
8260567.ch: 花儿好看是好看，但最终还是会枯萎的，好的事情总是只有那么一瞬间，随后就都是不开心的时光。

8260568.en: I don't agree with the philosophy of "eat, drink, and be merry," but I can certainly understand why others might live that way.
8260568.ch: 我虽然不认同什么今朝有酒今朝醉，但倒很能理解旁人为什么会这么做。

8260569.en: No way, no way! I've been running around clearing out monsters from this mystic realm. I'm beat!
8260569.ch: 不切不切！我清理这秘境之中的妖怪已经动手动脚了，累着呢！

8260570.en: Besides, I just want to chill here for a bit. It's nice to space out and relax every once in a while, you know?
8260570.ch: 而且啊，我只想这么呆着，偶尔能够安心发会呆也很不错呢。

8260571.en: Oh my, I really wish we could find a few more mystic realms to explore. We can't let this trip go to waste, right?
8260571.ch: 哎呀，真想多找几个秘境玩玩，不能白费这一趟呢。

8260572.en: Speaking of that, I actually found quite a few treasures when I first explored this realm. Here, let me show you what I've got!
8260572.ch: 说起不能白费，我在刚查探这个洞天时找到不少好东西呢，来给你玩玩。

8260573.en: Dual Cultivation? What does that mean? I'm just an innocent little girl, you know. Haha.
8260573.ch: 双修是什么意思？我小小女孩不懂。哈哈。

8260574.en: They say fish only have memories lasting a few seconds. If that's true, it might not be such a bad thing. Think about it: they live a carefree life and play happily, eat when they're hungry, and drink when they're thirsty. That's true contentment right there.
8260574.ch: 据说鱼儿记忆只有短短数息，假如为真，倒也不失为一件好事。你想想，什么都不知道，就能快快乐乐的玩，该吃吃，该喝喝，真正怡然自得。

8260575.en: What cultivators truly desire is nothing more than freedom. Blindly chasing after power is really putting the cart before the horse. But given the circumstances, it's hard to blame them. Sigh...
8260575.ch: 修仙者所想，不过“逍遥”二字。一味追求力量，总是本末倒置了。不过环境使然，倒也无可厚非。唉……

8260576.en: Worried about something? Not at all! Can't you see I'm having fun watching these silly little fish?
8260576.ch: 没有心事啊？这不是看着这些傻鱼儿乐着了吗？

8260577.en: Shall we take another stroll around the area?
8260577.ch: 我们再周围溜达一下吧？

8260578.en: Oh my, are you having fun? I hope hanging out with a little bad girl like me isn't boring you!
8260578.ch: 哎呀，玩得开心吗？陪着我这小鬼，会无聊吧？

8260579.en: Let's head out now! I had such a great time!
8260579.ch: 咱们这就离开吧！哎呀，真开心啊！

8260580.en: Ao Yao strides away, laughing and joking, but suddenly she feels something's wrong. She wipes her mouth with her hand, only to find her palm covered in deep crimson. As you look closer, you notice blood streaming from her nose, dripping steadily onto the ground.
8260580.ch: 敖瑶嬉笑着迈着大步离开，突然间她觉得有什么不妥，用手抹了抹嘴边，却见手掌一片殷红。你细看下，只见她鼻血长流，滴滴答答的落在地上。

8260581.en: I'm fine... Let's go. I must've worn myself out reshaping this mystic realm! I just need to rest for a bit.
8260581.ch: 我没事……咱们走吧，一定是重塑这片秘境太过劳累了！我去休息一下。

8260582.en: Ao Yao wipes her nose again and tries to take a step, but suddenly her body goes limp. With a soft thud, she collapses to the ground.
8260582.ch: 敖瑶又抹了抹鼻子，准备迈开步子走，但突然间，她身子软倒，噗的一声伏到地上。

8260583.en: As you lift Ao Yao, you find her barely clinging to life...
8260583.ch: 你扶起敖瑶时，她已奄奄一息……

8260585.en: Ao Yao manages to give you directions, but as soon as she finishes, her mind begins to cloud over. She starts mumbling incoherently, lost in delirium.
8260585.ch: 敖瑶指示你路径方位，但才刚刚说完神智便渐转混沌，嘴里一直在说着胡话。

8260586.en: I won't go back... It's so rare I get to come out...
8260586.ch: 我不回去……这么难得才出来一趟……

8260587.en: I can find my own way back...
8260587.ch: 我能找到回去的办法的……

8260588.en: You bring Ao Yao to the place she indicated. Before you stands a dwelling made of green bamboo, with a delicate pond nearby, encircled by smooth stones.
8260588.ch: 你带着敖瑶来到指定的地方，只见前方青竹为庐，旁边卵石围起，筑就一个精致池塘。

8260589.en: Thank you. This is my home. I'll be fine after a bit of rest. You should go now; aren't you busy? Go on with your cultivation. I've taken up too much of your time already.
8260589.ch: 谢谢，这里是我家，稍后我休息一下就好。你先走吧，你不是很忙吗？去继续修炼吧，我都耽误你好久了。

8260590.en: You quietly return to Ao Yao's dwelling, only to see her struggling to make her way to the edge of the pond. A rustling sound breaks the silence. Through the screen of flowers and trees, you catch a glimpse of Ao Yao removing her outer garments before stepping into the pond.
8260590.ch: 你静静的回到敖瑶住处，却见她强支着身子慢慢走到池塘边上。但听窸窣声起，花木掩映中，可见敖瑶褪下了外衣走入池塘里面。

8260591.en: A light mist rises from the pond, obscuring your view. You look closely as it dissipates, but Ao Yao has vanished without a trace.
8260591.ch: 那池子升起轻烟遮蔽视线，烟云散去后，仔细一看，敖瑶却已不见了。

8260592.en: You enter Ao Yao's dwelling to investigate. The pond shows only sparkling ripples, and Ao Yao is not here. Looking around, you realize that apart from the chirping of insects, the place is in fact shrouded in an unnatural silence. There's not a trace of human presence...
8260592.ch: 你进入敖瑶住处查探，只见池塘之中唯有粼粼水波，哪有敖瑶身影？然则回顾四方，除去虫语唧唧，周围静悄悄的毫无人类声息……

8260593.en: You arrive at Ao Yao's dwelling to find her standing by the pond, staring absently at the shimmering water. It's been days since you last saw her, and to your surprise, her once radiant beauty has given way to a haggard, worn appearance.
8260593.ch: 你来到敖瑶住处，只见她立在池子边上，看着面前水光发呆，数日不见，却见伊人憔悴非常，迥异往日秀美。

8260594.en: Oh my, you found your way here all by yourself!
8260594.ch: 哎呀，你自己摸到这来啦！

8260595.en: I'm perfectly fine! I could devour a whole Dangkang right now! Maybe even half a Coatl on top of that!
8260595.ch: 我好着呢，能吃下一整头当康！也许还能再吃下半条鸣蛇！

8260596.en: Huh? Are you sure you saw right? This pond is knee-deep at most. If I wanted to take a bath, I'd need a much bigger pool, don't you think?
8260596.ch: 啊！你是不是看错了？这池子撑死到膝盖，我要泡澡应该找个更大的池子吧？

8260597.en: That's a great idea! I'll tell you about the mystic realm I've discovered. You go on ahead, and I'll catch up soon.
8260597.ch: 这倒是个不错的主意！我将发现的秘境告诉你，你先去，我随后就来。

8260598.en: Are you ready? I guess there's bound to be a beautiful fox lady in the realm, and she may be waiting to make you her husband!
8260598.ch: 准备好了吗？要我说，里面肯定有个漂亮的女妖狐等着招你作丈夫噢！

8260600.en: Well, it's not that different, really. I'm sure this ghost lady was quite the beauty way back when! So, are you just picky about whether she's a fox or a ghost?
8260600.ch: 其实也没差啊，这女鬼很久很久以前肯定也很漂亮的！所以你介意的只是她是狐妖还是鬼魂吗？

8260601.en: Haha, there aren't any beautiful fox spirits at all, just ghosts. But hey, the prettiest one here is me!
8260601.ch: 哈哈，漂亮的女妖狐没有，只有女鬼。这里最漂亮的就是我！

8260602.en: You eliminate the monsters within the mystic realm, and Ao Yao begins to scour the area for treasures. Suddenly, she stumbles and collapses to her knees...
8260602.ch: 你们将秘境之中的妖物铲除，敖瑶则四处搜刮秘境中的宝物。但她突然一个趔趄跪倒在地……

8260603.en: At that very moment, a group of cultivators arrives together, surrounding Ao Yao.
8260603.ch: 正在此时，一群修仙者结伴来到，围住敖瑶。

8260604.en: It's her. I saw it with my own eyes...

8260605.en: Let's get this straight. After we kill her, who should be recognized as Dragon Slayer? Only one of us can claim it!
8260605.ch: 先说好，宰了她，这八荒屠龙者的称号谁要？称号只能一个人要。

8260606.en: I don't care who gets the title. I just want the dragon horn.
8260606.ch: 你们谁拿都可以，我只要龙角。

8260607.en: Hey, what do we do about this person here? The person wasn't around when we were tracking this dragon before!
8260607.ch: 喂，旁边这人怎么处理？早些日子跟踪这条龙时可没这人！

8260608.en: What's there to consider? Kill, or bury alive. Or better yet, kill and bury!
8260608.ch: 你还要怎么处理？要么杀了，要么埋了，或者也可以先杀了，再埋了！

8260609.en: We can't let this leak out!
8260609.ch: 说得极是，此事可不能泄露了风声！

8260610.en: You defeat the group, but suddenly a sharp whistle pierces the air. A spear plummets from the sky, impaling Ao Yao. She collapses on the spot, blood spilling everywhere.
8260610.ch: 你将众人击败，天空中忽发尖啸，一柄长剑当空落下刺中敖瑶，她当场摔倒，鲜血淋漓。

8260611.en: Let's split up. I'm their target, so you should avoid the crowd. <r>Meet me at my dwelling afterwards</r>.
8260611.ch: 咱们分头行动，他们目标是我，你避开众人，<r>随后来我住处汇合</r>。

8260612.en: Oh please, they'll never catch up to me!

8260613.en: As you help Ao Yao leave, you feel a warm, wet sensation on your hands. A glance reveals your palms are drenched in a strange, golden liquid...
8260613.ch: 你扶着敖瑶离开，只觉手上阵阵温热传来，余光看去，只见手中湿漉漉的全是玄黄之血……

8260614.en: Ao Yao gives you a slight nod before staggering away. Moments later, the sky erupts with a blinding flash of lightning. A surge of blue-green energy rises into the air, accompanied by a piercing howl. In the distance, a great commotion breaks out, punctuated by agonized screams. But in the blink of an eye, all falls silent once more.
8260614.ch: 敖瑶朝你微一点头，踉跄着绕到别处去了。不久后天空惊雷猛闪，一股青气腾空而起，嘶啸声中，远方声势大作，惨呼连发，但只眨眼间，便已平复。

8260615.en: Phew, we're finally safe. Those people will never find us here. Ah!
8260615.ch: 嘿嘿，轻而易举就摆脱了那些人了。看吧，他们可找不到这里来的。啊！

8260616.en: Ao Yao suddenly collapses to the ground. Patches of scales begin to appear on her face and hands...
8260616.ch: 敖瑶突然摔倒地上，她的脸上手上，呈现片片鳞片……

8260619.en: We're friends... but that doesn't mean I can't have secrets, right?
8260619.ch: 我们是朋友……那不代表我不能有秘密吧？

8260620.en: Hey, hey, hey! What's gotten into you? Tsk! Fine, fine, never mind!
8260620.ch: 哎哎哎？你这人是怎么了？啧！罢了罢了！

8260621.en: ...Just pretend you didn't see anything, okay?

8260622.en: Sigh. What do you want to know?
8260622.ch: 喂喂，你这是什么表情，好吧好吧！我知道了！你想知道什么嘛？

8260623.en: I'm... a dragon from the East Sea, but not the East Sea you know here.
8260623.ch: 我……是东海的龙族。但不是你们这里的东海。

8260625.en: I come from the East Sea in another dimension. That place is somewhat similar to here. It's likely a parallel realm, not the Upper Realm you speak of.
8260625.ch: 我来自别的位面的东海，那个地方和八荒有点像，应是差不多的位面，不是你们所说的上界。

8260626.en: I obtained some secrets of the River Chart there and used its power to transport myself to this world in one swift move.
8260626.ch: 那个位面之中有河图之会，我在那处获得了河图的一些秘密，并借其来到八荒。

8260627.en: I don't fully understand it myself. But these days, I suspect it's because I'm from another dimension. The way energy flows through my body is slightly different from those in this world.
8260627.ch: 具体我也不明白。但依我猜测，我们位面不一样，也导致灵力运转有别。

8260628.en: Unlike those who ascend through proper channels, I didn't achieve this dimensional leap through any orthodox means. That's why my body can't adapt to your world. Oh well, what can you expect from a dimensional stowaway like me?
8260628.ch: 而我并非通过飞升之类的途径达成跃迁，因此我的身体并不能适应八荒世界。唉，谁叫我是个“偷渡者”呢？

8260629.en: I suspect that my body will slowly crack and deteriorate until even my last breath is completely wiped away.
8260629.ch: 我猜，我的身体最后会慢慢崩裂损坏，最后一丝元魂也被彻底碾碎。

8260630.en: I've been exploring the hidden mystic realms scattered throughout the world, hoping to find clues that would allow me to harness the celestial power of the River Chart and return to my home world.
8260630.ch: 我四处查探隐藏在八荒的洞天秘境，就是盼望能够找到线索利用河图的星境之力，再次回归我原来的世界。

8260631.en: Unfortunately, I still haven't found a way back home.
8260631.ch: 只可惜，我四处探索，却是处处扑空，始终找不到那线索。

8260632.en: The universe itself is infinite, and even this world conceals countless mystic realms within it. Each of these realms, in turn, hides passages connecting to innumerable places. How could finding the right passage ever be an easy task?
8260632.ch: 宇宙无穷无尽，八荒之中本就暗藏无数洞天，这每一个洞天又暗藏连接无数位面的通道，要成功找到合适的通道回到自己的位面，又谈何容易呢？

8260633.en: Besides, I think this world is actually quite nice—a fascinating place, really. You should go now. I need some time to mull things over.
8260633.ch: 而且我觉得八荒其实也挺不错的，是个顶有趣的地方呢。你先走吧，我想想哈。

8260634.en: Oh, alright, alright. I get it. You can go now.
8260634.ch: 哎呀，我知道了我知道了。你先走吧。

8260635.en: Ao Yao's dwelling is eerily quiet. It seems she has gone out.
8260635.ch: 敖瑶住处之中，静悄悄的，看来人已外出。

8260636.en: On the desk, a letter bears a strange cluster of star patterns, reminiscent of a celestial dragon-horse dancing across the sky. In the corner are small characters, "The River brings forth the Chart; the Celestial River brings forth the Star Chart."
8260636.ch: 只见案上信纸上面画着奇怪的星纹团，观之似天马星龙。画角写着几个小字“河出图，天河星图”。

8260637.en: The chart shows a central circle connected to countless circles. These secondary circles branch out to the circles in the tertiary layer. With each new layer, the number of circles multiply.
8260637.ch: 图上一个圈圈连接着无数空心圆圈，第二级的空心圆圈又不断发散联通第三重的圆圈，每经过一重，空心圆圈就大量增加。

8260638.en: On the margin of the chart is a drawing. It shows two stick figures standing, with sharp angles behind them. Perhaps they are distant mountains? But the whole thing only resembles a child's doodle...
8260638.ch: 边上有一张图画，上面有两个小人站着，小人后面则有几个尖锐的角，不知道是否为远方山峦……而这似乎是顽童涂鸦之类的东西……

8260639.en: Hey, hey! Did you start rummaging through my things the moment I left? This is a lady's private chamber, you know!
8260639.ch: 喂喂，你是不是乘我走开了，就在翻我的东西！这好歹是本姑娘的闺房呢！

8260640.en: As the ancient saying goes, "The Yellow River brings forth the Chart, and the Luo River brings forth the Book." This is the River Chart, a celestial arrangement of stars resembling a dragon-horse. I've gained quite a lot from studying this chart!
8260640.ch: 古语有云，河出图，而洛出书。这就是河图，众星排布，彷如龙马。我在这河图之中得到不少好处呢！

8260641.en: In the cosmos, dimensions are interconnected. I'm using the principles in the chart to deduce a way back to my own plane. Unfortunately, with each layer I cross, countless new possibilities emerge.
8260641.ch: 宇宙之中位面与位面之间互相联结，我借河图之道推演回归我的位面的方法。只可惜，每越过一重，就会多出无数种可能。

8260642.en: What do you mean, you can't tell what this is? You really can't see it?!
8260642.ch: 这、这是什么，你没看出来？你竟没看出来！

8260643.en: Oh dear, I should've paid more attention when my father was teaching me the art of painting. Ah, but that's not the point! Never mind, let's not talk about that!
8260643.ch: 哎呀，看来当年我应该好好跟父王学学这丹青之道的，哎，不过这不是重点！不是，这个不说也罢！

8260644.en: I've been out searching for mystic realms, you know? I need to find the key that connects to my home dimension! So, what do you say? Given our successful teamwork before, do you want to help me out? I'll make it worth your while!
8260644.ch: 我这不是出去找秘境吗？我要找到那个可以辨明联通我位面的玄机！怎样？鉴于你我之前合作得不错，你要不要帮我？有偿噢！

8260645.en: Hehe, I know a super thrilling place. Let's go check it out!
8260645.ch: 嘻嘻，我知道一个地方，可刺激了。咱们去那走走！

8260646.en: Fine. Off you go with your important business!

8260647.en: If we go in, we might run into some pesky minor monsters, or maybe even a powerful demon king. Of course, we could also stumble upon a foul-mouthed cultivator, or perhaps a villain playing dead to tug at our heartstrings! So, shall we venture in?
8260647.ch: 从这进去可能有难缠的小妖，也可能是强大的妖王。当然，指不定是个嘴臭的修士，又或者诈尸骗取我们同情心的恶人！所以我们要不要进去？

8260648.en: The mystic realm is serene. A gentle stream gurgles before you, while a vast wilderness stretches into the distance, ending at the foot of mountains spanning the horizon. The mere sight of this landscape is enough to lift one's spirits.
8260648.ch: 秘境之中清幽安静，面前一弯流水汩汩的响，远方则是大片旷野，尽头处高山横亘，但观此境便足以叫人心怀大畅。

8260649.en: Ah, it's truly beautiful. If I hadn't come to this world, I would never have found so many fascinating places like this.
8260649.ch: 啊，这里面真美，如果不是来八荒一趟，还真找不到这么多有趣的地方呢。

8260650.en: Haha, isn't that wonderful? Sometimes when we set out to do something, all the things that happen along the way make us forget our purpose.
8260650.ch: 哈哈，这不是挺好的吗？有时候我们做一件事会因为中间发生各种事情而忘了此行真正目的。

8260651.en: I seek out mystic realms to admire their beautiful scenery, not just to slay monsters and dig up treasures, you know.
8260651.ch: 我找秘境是为了观赏美丽的风景的，不单单来这里打怪挖宝啊。

8260652.en: It would be so boring if we only came here to find a way back home. Besides, there are plenty of great things. Look at all the stuff I've found for you!
8260652.ch: 只是来找回去的方法就太无聊了，而且这里也有很不错的东西呢。你看我都给你找到了。

8260653.en: Alright, alright, I get it. You came here to help me. Happy now?
8260653.ch: 知道了，知道了，你是为了帮我而来的。可以了吧？

8260654.en: True, matters of life and death are of great importance. But who doesn't die? Death is the destination for us all.
8260654.ch: 不错，生死事大，可是谁不会死呢？死亡才是一切的归宿啊。

8260655.en: Yes, I must return. I've known this since the moment I arrived here.
8260655.ch: 是，我必须回去的。由我来到这里开始，我就知道了。

8260656.en: In the past, I always delighted in defying my royal father's wishes. I believe that we dragons should transform following our heart's desire, unfettered and free, roaming between heaven and earth.
8260656.ch: 以前我总是喜欢忤逆父王的心意。我认为龙，应该变化为由心，无拘无束，往来天地之间。

8260657.en: But since coming here, my thoughts changed. Everything here is unknown, and I've found people who can accompany me on this journey.
8260657.ch: 可当我来到八荒，心境却有些变化了。这里一切都是未知，这里有可以陪着我的人。

8260658.en: I'm starting to feel like I don't want to go back at all. I suppose my royal father would think I've been in the wrong from the very beginning.
8260658.ch: 我都有点不想回去了呢。如果从父王的角度来看，从一开始我就错了。

8260659.en: But for me, all of this might be right... I think I've come to the right place. This is where I belong, isn't it?
8260659.ch: 但这一切对于我，也许是对的……我想我来对了地方了，这里就是我的归宿吧。

8260660.en: Besides, going back would be incredibly difficult. The endless possibilities ahead of me are overwhelming—just thinking about it is disheartening.
8260660.ch: 而且啊，要回去真的太难了，我面前将是无穷无尽的可能性，让人看着就很灰心。

8260661.en: Yes, yes, yes, I know I'm being difficult! But don't you dare lecture me with that stern face!
8260661.ch: 是是是，我知道自己不好！你可不准板起脸来训我。

8260662.en: Sigh, is it really that hard to understand? (murmuring)
8260662.ch: 唉，这很难理解吗？（低声说）

8260663.en: Fine, have it your way. It won't happen again. I won't make light of my own life, I promise.
8260663.ch: 嗯，依你。下不为例，我也不会拿自己性命开玩笑的。

8260664.en: Hey, hey, hey! Are you being sarcastic with me?

8260665.en: I know, I know. I'm just being silly for one day. After this, I'll give it my all to find a way back home. Promise.
8260665.ch: 我知道的，我就胡闹这么一天，后面一定会全力以赴，找到回去的办法的。

8260666.en: I'm only asking you to join me in this little escapade for one day, really.
8260666.ch: 我也只是要你陪我玩一天。真的，我已经下定决心到华封州去继续寻找洞天秘境，依我推断，回归的通道不在永宁州，即在华封州。

8260667.en: Ao Yao gives you a gentle smile, then leaves this place in reluctant, heavy steps...
8260667.ch: 敖瑶朝你微微一笑，这才万分不舍地离开此地……

8260668.en: Let's go! We'll punch evil cultivators and kick demon kings. Who could possibly stand in our way?
8260668.ch: 走啦！咱们拳打邪修，脚踢妖王，怕过谁来？

8260669.en: Ao Yao eagerly pulls you into the mystic realm. The mystic realm is serene. A gentle stream gurgles before you, while a vast wilderness stretches into the distance, ending at the foot of mountains spanning the horizon. The mere sight of this landscape is enough to lift one's spirits.
8260669.ch: 敖瑶把你强拉进，秘境之中清幽安静，面前一弯流水汩汩的响，远方则是一片旷野，尽头处大山横亘，但观此境便足以叫人心怀大畅。

8260672.en: Hey, you're here! Listen, last time when I was out scouting on my own, I saw a female cultivator secretly following you. Her eyes were all dewy with admiration. Don't tell me you've been playing the charmer and picked up a fangirl!
8260672.ch: 喂，你来了？我跟你说，上回我自个出去查探的时候，看见一个女修悄悄的跟踪你，眼里水汪汪的。是不是你风流成性，招惹了什么小迷妹呀！

8260673.en: Well, haha! Since you've come all this way, you might as well accompany me on an adventure. My life is counting on you, you know! I'm heading over first, and don't you dare not show up!
8260673.ch: 呸，哈哈！你一场来到，陪我出去走，我这条小命可等着你来帮忙救呢！我先过去，你不准不来！

8260674.en: Hey, hey! You're adventuring with a gorgeous lady, so there must be some really tough monsters waiting for us inside. That's how these things work, right?
8260674.ch: 喂喂，和我这么漂亮的人一起探险，所以里面一定有很厉害妖怪等着咱们噢。

8260675.en: Tee-hee. Being with someone as stunning as me, you've already got all the luck in the world. But you know what they say—what goes up must come down! You've had your share of good fortune, so some misfortune is bound to follow!
8260675.ch: 噗呲，你跟我这么好看的人儿在一起，已经占尽了天下的好处了。俗话说天道好还，你拿了好处，肯定也会有坏事的啊！

8260676.en: Sigh, the thing I was looking for isn't here. But wouldn't you know it, there's plenty of stuff that's perfect for you! How infuriating!
8260676.ch: 唉，我要找的东西是没有的，不过适合你的东西却不少呢！真气人！

8260677.en: Ao Yao's expression seems tinged with disappointment, but she manages a soft smile. Her demeanor suggests a mix of letdown and, paradoxically, a hint of relief.
8260677.ch: 敖瑶神色似乎有些失落，但又轻轻的笑了笑，似乎既充斥失望亦有点松了口气的感觉。

8260678.en: Of course, I'm disappointed about not finding a way back, but then again, this means I get to stay here a bit longer. Are you going to miss me? Our time together is precious, you know. Each moment we spend is one we'll never get back.
8260678.ch: 找不到回去的办法当然会失望，但转念一想，这样我就能继续留在八荒了啊。嘿嘿，有没有舍不得我？跟我在一起的时光啊，那可是越来越少了啊。

8260679.en: Oh, right! I understand how you feel, and I promise I won't give up!
8260679.ch: 对了，我知道你的心意，我不会放弃的！

8260680.en: Ao Yao flashes you a playful grin before striding off, taking the lead. As she walks, she pulls out a handkerchief from inside her robe and dabs at her nose. You catch a glimpse of the fair cloth, now marred by alarming splotches of red...
8260680.ch: 敖瑶朝你嘻嘻一笑，大踏步当先离开。期间她抽出衣服内的帕子抹了抹鼻子，你依稀见得那白皙的手绢上赫然有大块嫣红的血迹……

8260681.en: You arrive at Ao Yao's dwelling. She sits idly by the door; her once crystal-clear skin now exudes a deathly dark aura, and her eyes have lost all traces of life. However, upon seeing you, she immediately puts on a brave face.
8260681.ch: 你来到敖瑶住处，她正倚在湖边，晶莹的肌肤上透出一股死黑之气，眼中也变得毫无生气。但她见了你后，立即打起了精神。

8260682.en: Hey! Hurry, hurry! Come with me somewhere! If you'd been any later, I might have dozed off from boredom.
8260682.ch: 喂，快快快，陪我去个地方！你要再来晚些我都要睡着了。

8260683.en: Ao Yao musters her strength to stand up with a hint of her usual vivacity. But after just two steps, she stumbles and falls against you.
8260683.ch: 敖瑶强打精神站了起来，恢复了几分风采，但她才走两步便一个趔趄摔到你身上。

8260684.en: Isn't it obvious? I'm this tired because I've been working so hard to find a way out of here!
8260684.ch: 我这不是很努力的找离开的方法才这么累吗？

8260685.en: Ao Yao tries her best to stand on her own, but her body seems drained of energy. She could only lean against you for support, at least for now.
8260685.ch: 敖瑶努力想要自己站定，但似乎浑身乏力，只得暂时靠在你身上。

8260686.en: You don't have the power of the River Chart, so how could you possibly search? Of course, I had to go and do it myself.
8260686.ch: 你又没获得河图的力量，你怎么找？还不得我亲自走一趟。

8260687.en: Let me lean on you for a bit... It's not that I don't want to get up, I just... can't hold on any longer.
8260687.ch: 让我靠一下吧……不是不想起来，就是有点撑不住了。

8260688.en: You know... the truth is, I'm really scared. I think... I'm actually dying...
8260688.ch: 跟你说，其实我还是很害怕的，原来自己的生命已经快走到头了……

8260689.en: My royal father always says I'll cause trouble, and I resent it from the bottom of my heart. Where, and how, have I caused trouble?
8260689.ch: 父王总说我会闯祸，我打心底里反感。我哪里闯祸了？我怎么闯祸了？

8260690.en: But this time... I really have made a mess of things... I want to see him... I don't want to die...
8260690.ch: 然而这次真的闯祸了……我想见见他……我不想死……

8260691.en: After speaking, Ao Yao quietly leans against you. A long moment passes before she stands up again, her face now beaming with her usual cheerful demeanor.
8260691.ch: 敖瑶说完便静静的靠在你身边，良久良久她重新站起，已笑嘻嘻的恢复了往日神采。

8260692.en: Why do you look so dazed? Did I scare you? Hehe, I was just kidding! Come on, come on! Keep up!
8260692.ch: 怎么看起来呆呆的，被我吓到了吧？嘿嘿，我逗你玩呢！走走走！快跟上！

8260693.en: Ao Yao strides ahead with these words. You move to follow, but suddenly, you notice two droplets on the back of your hand. They seem to be tears Ao Yao shed while leaning against you...
8260693.ch: 敖瑶说着已大踏步走在前头，你正想跟上，却发现手背上莫名有两颗水滴，而那似乎是敖瑶靠在你身边时暗暗落下的泪水……

8260694.en: Are you ready? Shall we go in?
8260694.ch: 准备好了吗？我们进去吧？

8260695.en: Who's fragile? I'm brimming with power now! I could take on ten bandit cultivators at once! Look! This fist packs a punch, doesn't it?
8260695.ch: 哪那么娇弱？我现在充满力量，就来十个抢劫的修士也一并收拾了！看！这拳很有力吧！

8260696.en: Ao Yao swings her fist toward you, but midway through, her movement becomes gentle. She ends up lightly touching your cheek. All you feel is the warmth of her smooth skin and a hint of fragrance from her delicate hand.
8260696.ch: 敖瑶朝你挥出一拳，然而拳到中途，变得十分轻缓，最后轻轻地碰了你的脸一下。你只感觉到她温暖滑腻的肌肤，和素手上若有若无的香气。

8260697.en: I, the Princess of the Dragon Palace in the East Sea, have arrived with my mighty general! All you spirits, demons, specters, and monsters in this mystic realm, surrender now if you know what's good for you!
8260697.ch: 东海龙宫公主带领座下大将来讨，洞天秘境之中的山精妖怪，邪祟恶魔，识相的赶紧投降了！

8260698.en: Suddenly, star patterns appear on Ao Yao's wrist.
8260698.ch: 敖瑶手腕上突然出现星纹，

8260699.en: Ah! I've found it... This is the way to leave here and return to my own plane of existence...
8260699.ch: 啊！找到了……这就是离开八荒，回归我所在位面的方法……

8260700.en: Ao Yao looks at you, her eyes gleaming with excitement. However, this spark soon fades, replaced by a hint of sadness. She turns and stumbles back toward her dwelling, her steps unsteady.
8260700.ch: 敖瑶看向你，眼中放出闪亮的光芒，然而这兴奋的神光迅速黯淡下去，她似乎变得有点难过，只踉踉跄跄的朝自己住处回去。

8260701.en: You arrive at Ao Yao's dwelling, but no one is there. It seems she has gone out.
8260701.ch: 你来到敖瑶的住处，然而室内空无一人，她似乎外出了。

8260702.en: You arrive at Ao Yao's dwelling. Inside, a thin layer of dust has settled on the writing desk.
8260702.ch: 你来到敖瑶的住处，里面案桌已薄薄铺上一层尘埃。

8260703.en: You find Ao Yao leaning against a large tree for support, a handkerchief in her hand. The cloth is stained a deep crimson as if she's just wiped away blood...
8260703.ch: 你找到了敖瑶，其时她正拿着一块手帕正扶着身边大树正在歇息，那块手帕上一片殷红，似乎刚擦过血迹……

8260705.en: Um, you know staying here always takes a toll on my body. I've been a bit worn out lately, so...
8260705.ch: 呃，你知道我留在八荒，身体总是遭罪的。最近又有点累了，因此……

8260706.en: Oh my, did you come looking for me? What a shame, I wasn't home! Otherwise, I would've dragged you out on an adventure with me!
8260706.ch: 哎呀，你来找我了吗？可惜了，我没在家里，不然拉上你一起外出！

8260707.en: Go back? I've still got some preparation to do!
8260707.ch: 回去？我还得准备准备呢！

8260708.en: You came at just the right time! This mystic realm has opened up. Let's go in and conquer it!
8260708.ch: 你来了就对了！这处洞天已经打开，咱们进去扫荡一番！

8260709.en: It's a good thing you're here. There are so many valuable items, it'd be a shame if no one took them.
8260709.ch: 幸好你来了。好东西这么多，没人要的话就可惜了。

8260710.en: After handing you the treasures she found, Ao Yao's nose suddenly starts bleeding profusely. She looks startled and reaches for her handkerchief to wipe away the blood, but before she can react, she collapses to the ground.
8260710.ch: 敖瑶将找到的宝物给到你后，突然间鼻血滴滴答答的落在地上，她露出讶色，想掏出帕子将血擦掉，然而未等她反应过来，已一下晕倒在地。

8260711.en: Put me in the courtyard pool... The water there will heal me...
8260711.ch: 将我放到院中池子里，那里面的水对我有疗愈之功……

8260712.en: You lower Ao Yao into the pool, submerging her body in the water. Within moments, the ruby color returns to her pale face.
8260712.ch: 你将敖瑶放到池子之中，让池水浸漫她身子，只片刻间她苍白的脸上重新漫上血色。

8260713.en: Oh my, it's a good thing you brought me back here. It would've been quite a predicament if I had fainted out there.
8260713.ch: 哎呀，亏得你将我送回来了。不然晕倒在外可不好办。

8260715.en: Because I still want to explore this world! The world has endless sights to see. There are so many places I haven't been to yet, and so many mystic realms I haven't opened!
8260715.ch: 因为还想周围看看啊，八荒有看不尽的景色呢，还有很多地方我没去过，很多洞天没打开过呢。

8260716.en: I do value my life, you know. It's precisely because I value it that I don't want to have any regrets.
8260716.ch: 我可爱惜自己的性命了，正因为爱惜性命这才不想有所后悔。

8260717.en: What's gotten into you? Are you that eager for me to leave? Have you considered that if I go back, I might never be able to return? Am I that much of a burden to you?
8260717.ch: 你现在是怎么了？就这么想我离开？你有没有想过我回去了，就再也回不来了？我就这么讨你嫌吗？

8260718.en: I simply don't want to leave right now. I'm going to find a way to return here. Is that a problem?
8260718.ch: 我现在就是不想走。我要找到回到这边的方法，有什么问题吗？

8260719.en: Since you first met Ao Yao, you've never seen her angry. After this outburst, she abruptly turns her head away, seemingly trying to suppress the fury burning within her.
8260719.ch: 自与敖瑶相识以来从未见其生气，她这一顿说完一把扭开了头，似乎正抑制自己心中怒火。

8260720.en: I know what I'm doing. You needn't concern yourself with it.
8260720.ch: 唉，你别跟我说这些有的没的，我自己心里有数，你不要来管我！

8260722.en: I'm tired. You should go. I just need to rest for a bit.
8260722.ch: 累了，你走吧。我歇会就好。

8260723.en: Ao Yao's face turns icy cold. After speaking, she turns her face away, refusing to talk further.
8260723.ch: 敖瑶脸若寒霜，她说完就偏过了脸，不再理你。

8260726.en: Hah, why are you here? Going to lecture me with that stern face again? Back in the day, hardly anyone dared to scold me all year round. I won't put up with that nonsense.
8260726.ch: 呵，你来干嘛？又要板起脸训我？从前一年到头就没几人敢训我，本姑娘不吃这套。

8260728.en: Yes! Let's make sure neither of us has any regrets!

8260729.en: Great! Now I have even less to worry about. If I fainted, you can just drag me back here.
8260729.ch: 好啊，那我现在就更无后顾之忧啦，倒了你把我拖回来就好了。

8260730.en: No time to waste! Let's set out right now!
8260730.ch: 事不宜迟，我们现在就出发！

8260731.en: As expected, it's the same old argument. No one could stop me from setting out, and no one could hold me back when I decided to leave.
8260731.ch: 果然还是这套说辞。本姑娘来时谁也挡不住，要走了，也没人能拦下。

8260732.en: If you don't say anything, how am I supposed to know if you're worried...
8260732.ch: 你不说，谁知道你是不是担心……

8260733.en: Just go. I don't want to talk to you anymore.
8260733.ch: 你走吧，我不想跟你说话。

8260734.en: You arrive at Ao Yao's dwelling, only to find it completely deserted. There's not a trace of recent habitation...
8260734.ch: 你来到敖瑶的住处，然则人去楼空，居处已无人迹……

8260735.en: In the inner chamber, you find an array of Heaven and Earth Treasures. These items are meticulously arranged as if someone had carefully prepared them for your arrival.
8260735.ch: 内室之中，摆放着若干天材地宝。这些东西整整齐齐的摆着，似乎是有人为来者悉心准备的。

8260736.en: On the desk, a paperweight holds down a letter.
8260736.ch: 案上有一块纸镇，上面压着一张信笺。

8260737.en: I've always felt that saying farewell is a terribly sad affair.
8260737.ch:
我总觉得道别是一件十分悲伤的事。特别是知道说了再见之后其实是无法再见的，就更让人难过了。
但如果不跟你道这个别，我又割舍不下。既然如此，还是郑重的道个别吧。我不知道你是怎么看待我的，但是在相处的这些时光里，我已把你当成最好的朋友。
我不知道你是怎么看待我的，但是在相处的这些时光里，我已把你当成最好的朋友。
我想一直留在八荒，这样就能一直缠着你。我想这就是所谓喜欢吧。
我知道你的心思都用在突破修炼上了，因此我将这些天材地宝留给你。希望你一切顺利。
别了。

8260738.en: It's especially heartbreaking when you know that "see you again" actually means you'll never see each other again.
8260738.ch: 特别是知道说了再见之后其实是无法再见的，就更让人难过了。

8260739.en: But if I don't say goodbye to you, I can't bring myself to leave. So, I've decided to bid you a proper farewell.
8260739.ch: 但如果不跟你道这个别，我又割舍不下。既然如此，还是郑重的道个别吧。

8260740.en: I'm not sure how you see me, but during our time together, I've come to consider you my best friend.
8260740.ch: 我不知道你是怎么看待我的，但是在相处的这些时光里，我已把你当成最好的朋友。

8260741.en: I wish I could stay in this world forever, so I could keep pestering you.
8260741.ch: 我想一直留在八荒，这样就能一直缠着你。

8260742.en: I suppose this is what they call love.
8260742.ch: 我想这就是所谓喜欢吧。

8260743.en: I know your mind is focused on your cultivation, so I'm leaving these Heaven and Earth Treasures for you.
8260743.ch: 我知道你的心思都用在突破修炼上了，因此我将这些天材地宝留给你。

8260744.en: I hope everything goes well for you.

8260746.en: Let's head in now! We'll find it and leave quickly. If we reach the right spot, the star patterns on me will resonate!
8260746.ch: 咱们这就进去了吧！赶紧找到就走，一旦有对应的地方我身上的河图星纹定有应和！

8260747.en: Oh, no! The mystic realm is collapsing. We need to get out of here, now!
8260747.ch: 不妙！这个秘境正在毁灭，我们赶紧撤！

8260748.en: Sigh. It was already like looking for a needle in a haystack... and now we have all these setbacks on top of that.
8260748.ch: 唉，本就大海捞针一般……偏偏还有这许多不顺。

8260749.en: She slumps to the ground, crestfallen.
8260749.ch: 她好像泄了气似的坐倒地上。

8260751.en: I didn't say anything, but I was just wishing you'd sit with me for a while. And then you did.
8260751.ch: 虽然我不说，但这时候我正盼着你能陪我坐一会。嘻嘻，然后你就坐下来了。

8260753.en: Ao Yao smiles softly. She shifts her position, gently bumps your shoulder with hers, and then leans against you carefully. You and her sit side by side.
8260753.ch: 敖瑶微微一笑，挪了挪身子，然后用肩膀轻轻撞了撞你，轻轻靠着你，与你并肩坐着。

8260754.en: I wish we could just sit here like this forever, never moving an inch.
8260754.ch: 真想就这么坐着，永远都不动啊。

8260756.en: Ao Yao mutters half a sentence as if talking to herself, then stands up. A look of resignation crosses her face, but she forces a smile before turning and walking away.
8260756.ch: 敖瑶自言自语似的说了半句话便自己站了起来，她神情有点无奈，最后还是强颜一笑，转身离开了。

8260757.en: Indeed... Time is running out, and we don't have many days left. I'm really going to miss this...
8260757.ch: 是啊，时间紧迫，剩下的日子不多了，真舍不得呢……

8260761.en: Mm-hmm, I'll come find you again next time! And. Don't. You. Dare. Refuse!
8260761.ch: 嗯，下回我还找你！不、准、推、辞！

8260762.en: Hey! Can you come with me for a bit? I've found a mystic realm! It's not far from here, so let's go?
8260762.ch: 喂，可以陪我一下可以吗？找到秘境了呢！就在这边不远来吧？

8260763.en: Well? Shall we go in and take a look?

8260764.en: Haha! So this is the so-called demon king? Even though I've been terribly ill since coming here and my power severely weakened, I still managed to take down this without breaking a sweat! Looks like I'm pretty awesome after all!
8260764.ch: 哈哈，这就是妖王吗？来到八荒后，我的身体严重不适，实力大打折扣，这还能轻而易举的收拾了这玩意！看来我本事不弱嘛！

8260766.en: I am happy, you know. It's because you're here with me. Let me tell you, if you weren't by my side, I'd have been utterly devastated when I couldn't find any clues.
8260766.ch: 是很开心，因为你陪着啊。我跟你说，如果不是你在边上，找不到线索时我可要失望透顶了。
